title: Towards Long-horizon Embodied Agents with Tool-Aligned Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.13119v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are effective robot action executors, but they remain limited on long-horizon tasks due to the dual burden of extended closed-loop planning and diverse physical operations. We therefore propose VLAs-as-Tools, a strategy that distributes this burden across a high-level vision language model (VLM) agent for temporal reasoning and a family of specialized VLA tools for diverse local physical operations. The VLM handles scene analysis, global planning, and recovery, while each VLA tool executes a bounded subtask. To tightly couple agent planning with VLA tool execution in long-horizon tasks, we introduce a VLA tool-family interface that exposes explicit tool selection and in-execution progress feedback, enabling efficient event-triggered agent replanning without continuous agent polling. To obtain diverse specialized VLA tools that faithfully follow agent invocations, we further propose Tool-Align

translated_title: 迈向基于工具对齐视觉-语言-动作模型的长时程具身智能体
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是有效的机器人动作执行器，但由于长时间闭环规划与多样化物理操作的双重负担，它们在长时程任务上仍然受限。因此，我们提出了VLAs-as-Tools策略，将该负担分配给负责时序推理的高层视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体和负责多样化局部物理操作的专业VLA工具家族。VLM负责场景分析、全局规划与恢复，而每个VLA工具执行一个有界的子任务。为了在长时程任务中将智能体规划与VLA工具执行紧密耦合，我们引入了一个VLA工具家族接口，该接口提供显式的工具选择和执行过程中的进度反馈，从而无需智能体持续轮询即可实现高效的事件触发式重规划。为了获得忠实遵循智能体调用的多样化专业VLA工具，我们进一步提出了Tool-Align方法
tldr: 提出VLAs-as-Tools策略，将长时程任务分工给负责时序推理的VLM智能体与专业VLA工具家族，并通过提供工具选择与进度反馈的接口实现高效事件触发式重规划。
en_tdlr: Proposes VLAs-as-Tools, which distributes long-horizon task burden between a high-level VLM agent for temporal reasoning and specialized VLA tools for physical operations, coupled through a tool-family interface enabling efficient event-triggered replanning.
